en.stem: How many integers from 1 to 20 inclusive are divisible by 3?

questions.stem: 一个长方形长5厘米、宽3厘米，周长多少厘米？

questions.stem: 抽屉里只有红袜和蓝袜。闭眼至少拿几只袜子，才能保证有两只同色？
questions.stemEn: A drawer has only red and blue socks. How many must you take to guarantee two of the same color?
questions.solution: 最多先拿到一红一蓝，第3只一定与其中一只同色。

zh.stem: 抽屉里只有红袜和蓝袜。闭眼至少拿几只袜子，才能保证有两只同色？
zh.solution: 最多先拿到一红一蓝，第3只一定与其中一只同色。

en.stem: A drawer has only red and blue socks. How many must you take to guarantee two of the same color?
en.solution: At worst, the first two are different; the third matches one.

questions.stem: 小乐排队时前面8人、后面5人，这队共有多少人？
questions.stemEn: There are 8 people ahead of Lele and 5 behind. How many people are in the line?

zh.stem: 小乐排队时前面8人、后面5人，这队共有多少人？

en.stem: There are 8 people ahead of Lele and 5 behind. How many people are in the line?

questions.stem: 一个两位数的十位数字是4，两个数字的和是9，这个数是多少？
questions.stemEn: A two-digit number has tens digit 4 and its digits add to 9. What is the number?

zh.stem: 一个两位数的十位数字是4，两个数字的和是9，这个数是多少？

en.stem: A two-digit number has tens digit 4 and its digits add to 9. What is the number?
en.solution: The ones digit is 9−4=5, so the number is 45.

questions.stem: 现在是2点45分，过30分钟后，距离4点还有多少分钟？
questions.stemEn: It is 2:45. After 30 minutes, how many minutes remain until 4:00?

zh.stem: 现在是2点45分，过30分钟后，距离4点还有多少分钟？

en.stem: It is 2:45. After 30 minutes, how many minutes remain until 4:00?
en.solution: Thirty minutes later is 3:15, leaving 45 minutes.

questions.stem: 三个连续整数的和是36，中间那个整数是多少？
questions.stemEn: Three consecutive integers add to 36. What is the middle integer?

zh.stem: 三个连续整数的和是36，中间那个整数是多少？

en.stem: Three consecutive integers add to 36. What is the middle integer?
en.solution: The middle number is the average: 36÷3=12.

questions.stem: 5篮橘子，每篮6个，拿走8个后还剩多少个？

zh.stem: 5篮橘子，每篮6个，拿走8个后还剩多少个？

en.stem: Five baskets each hold 6 oranges. If 8 are taken away, how many remain?

questions.stem: 小于100的最大7的倍数是多少？
questions.stemEn: What is the greatest multiple of 7 less than 100?

zh.stem: 小于100的最大7的倍数是多少？

en.stem: What is the greatest multiple of 7 less than 100?

questions.stem: 一个2行2列的小方格图（由4个相同小正方形组成），一共有多少个正方形？
questions.stemEn: A 2-by-2 grid is made of 4 equal small squares. How many squares of all sizes are there?
questions.solution: 4个小正方形加1个大正方形，共5个。

zh.stem: 一个2行2列的小方格图（由4个相同小正方形组成），一共有多少个正方形？
zh.solution: 4个小正方形加1个大正方形，共5个。

en.stem: A 2-by-2 grid is made of 4 equal small squares. How many squares of all sizes are there?
en.solution: Four small squares plus one large square make 5.

questions.stem: 从A、B、C三张不同的卡片中选2张排成一排，有多少种排法？
questions.stemEn: Choose 2 different cards from A, B and C and place them in order. How many arrangements?

zh.stem: 从A、B、C三张不同的卡片中选2张排成一排，有多少种排法？

en.stem: Choose 2 different cards from A, B and C and place them in order. How many arrangements?
en.solution: Three choices for the first, two for the second: 3×2=6.

questions.stem: 4个朋友彼此握手，每两人只握一次手，一共握几次？
questions.stemEn: Four friends each shake hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes occur?

zh.stem: 4个朋友彼此握手，每两人只握一次手，一共握几次？

en.stem: Four friends each shake hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes occur?
en.solution: 4×3÷2=6 because each handshake involves two people.

questions.stem: 24颗糖每袋最多装5颗，全部装完至少需要几个袋子？

en.stem: Each bag holds at most 5 candies. How many bags are needed for 24 candies?
en.solution: Four bags hold only 20, so 5 bags are needed.

questions.stemEn: Complete the pattern: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ...
questions.solution: 差依次为1、2、3、4、5，下一次加6得到22。

zh.solution: 差依次为1、2、3、4、5，下一次加6得到22。

en.stem: Complete the pattern: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ...
en.solution: The differences are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; add 6 to get 22.
